d:
For generations, musicians and poets have gathered in intimate mehfils to sing out the epics of kings, the sighs of lovers, and the deep secrets of the mystical.
is inspired by this storytelling tradition. Borrowing from the spiritual essence of Afsana Goyi, this track brings a fresh fable to life. At its centre are Sheikh and Hoor two characters whose journey feels mythical, unfolding not just as a song you listen to, but as a story told intricately. This ethereal rock tale is brought together by a trio of magical voices – , .nizami & each elevating the song with their own unique touch.
